notes.text: Lists and player names copied from mtgtop8, which took them from the organizer's (Card Titan's) Melee page; the lists were not compared card for card against Melee.

Placings and seeds are from the organizer's Melee page: seeds are the standings after the last Swiss round, and placings follow its playoff matches (quarterfinals: Max Gilmore def. mbatista 2-0; Chad Uzzell def. Stefan Vastek 2-1; Dave Kaplan def. andrewslafreniere 2-0; Jeremy Henry def. Greg Mitchell 2-0. Semifinals: Dave Kaplan def. Chad Uzzell 2-0; Jeremy Henry def. Max Gilmore 2-0. Final: Jeremy Henry def. Dave Kaplan 2-0). They agree with mtgtop8's at every tier.
Swiss was played on 2025-10-10; mtgtop8 dates the event to that day. The Top 8 was played on 2025-10-11.
Archetype names are MTGGoldfish's, for consistency across events.
